title: can't get Option key mapped to Alt key

comment.body: Your follow-up appears to reverse which physical Option key works compared with the original report. Could you confirm the current result for the left Option key and the right Option key using the same Option-to-Alt mapping—specifically, which one fails to produce Alt? That is the only detail needed to make this report reproducible.
